audit.why: 49.91% over 527 games and the chart gives Maokai five of seven stages — a level-1 steal followed by a long concession. The prose already says exactly that.
Spikes are placed correctly: your level 1, his levels 2-3 once Twisted Advance exists, his first tank item, his two-item frontline. Nothing needed moving.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Maokai ability is named, and the page's central instruction — poke him with Comet Spear — is the one thing that makes his sustain worse for you.
audit.why: Riot's Sap Magic text: 'Maokai's basic attack also heals him and deals additional damage on a moderate cooldown. Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.' Every spear you land shortens the timer on his heal. The page repeatedly tells you to poke and then complains that his healing 'erases the poke I land', without ever connecting the two. That inverts the advice: spell poke into Maokai is self-defeating, and what you want is either a full committal trade or nothing. Second miss: Twisted Advance makes him untargetable for the dash, so a Shield Vault or Comet Spear thrown at the start of it is wasted.
audit.corrected: Sap Magic's cooldown reduction on spell hits written into early and mid, Twisted Advance's untargetable dash into mid, and all five abilities named.

audit.why: Twisted Advance is 14/13/12/11/10s and is the only thing in his kit that locks you down for the rest of the combo — that number is the entire engage window. Bramble Smash is 7s down to 5s and Sapling Toss 18s down to 14s. Nature's Grasp is 130s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Twisted Advance's 14s written into mid and wants.you[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite healing being named as the reason you lose the lane.
audit.why: Sap Magic is the whole matchup and Grievous Wounds is the direct answer, yet the page names the healing four times and never mentions the item that stops it.

edits.after: Twisted Advance roots you for a free Bramble Smash, and Sap Magic's heal comes back faster every time one of your spells hits him — poke feeds it.

edits.before: Level 1 is the one window that's truly mine — my W stun plus an auto is one of the hardest level-1 hits in the game, so if he walks up for a cannon I vault him and win that exchange clean. But the second he gets his W root-dash and Q online, the lane flips: if he roots me with W, his Q knockback and a sapling free-trade me, and his passive tree-healing erases the poke I land. Don't greed a level-2/3 all-in into a tank with root and sustain — bank the level-1 edge and respect his combo.
edits.after: Level 1 is the one window truly mine — Shield Vault plus an auto is one of the hardest level-1 hits in the game, so if he walks up for a cannon I vault him and win it clean. Once Twisted Advance and Bramble Smash are online the lane flips. And read Sap Magic properly: being struck by a spell shortens its cooldown, so every Comet Spear I chip him with buys back his heal sooner. Poke does not beat him here. Bank the level-1 edge and commit only in full.

edits.before: Through 4-6 he's the one stabilizing, not me. His saplings and passive healing out-sustain my Comet Spear poke, and every time I W in he can W-root me back for a Q knockback trade I lose. Use my E channel to eat his Q and sapling damage from one direction while I reset spacing. At 6, Grand Starfall isn't a 1v1 kill button here — it's my map pressure, so leap to a sidelane or gank rather than trying to solo a tank who just heals it back.
edits.after: Through 4-6 he stabilises, not me. Sapling Toss and Sap Magic out-sustain my chip, and Twisted Advance roots me back for a Bramble Smash trade I lose. It is 14s at rank 1, and he is untargetable during the dash, so a spear thrown at the start of it is thrown away — wait for the root to land, then answer. Face Aegis Assault at his saplings while I reset spacing. At 6, Grand Starfall is map pressure, not a solo kill on a tank who heals it back.

edits.before: This is all his. By two items Maokai is a near-unkillable frontline with W root, Q knockback, and constant passive healing, while my damage has plateaued and squishy frame shows. I can't 1v1 him and I can't burst through his tank stats. My only late value is catching his carries with Grand Starfall flanks and using W to peel — never get caught alone, because one W root from him is a free combo and I have no sustain to survive it.
edits.after: This is all his. By two items Maokai is a near-unkillable frontline with Twisted Advance, Bramble Smash and constant Sap Magic healing, while my damage plateaus. Grievous Wounds is the only thing that makes his health bar move, and nothing on my page had said so. I can't 1v1 him regardless. My late value is flanking his carries with Grand Starfall and peeling with Shield Vault — never get caught alone, because one root is a free combo.

notes: THE FINDING IS SAP MAGIC. Riot's text: 'Each time Maokai casts a spell or is struck by an enemy's spell, this cooldown is reduced.' The page's core instruction was to poke him with Comet Spear, and it then complained four separate times that his healing 'erases the poke I land' — without ever noticing that the poke is what refreshes the heal. Chip damage into Maokai is self-defeating; the page now says so, and recommends Grievous Wounds, which it had never mentioned despite naming his healing as the reason the lane is lost. Second addition: Twisted Advance makes him untargetable for the duration of the dash, so a Comet Spear or Shield Vault spent as he starts it is wasted — you wait for the root to land. Neither of those was on the page and both are in _missing-interactions.json. Note also that champ-data/_kits/maokai.json tags Sapling Toss with 'knockup'; nothing in Riot's description supports that, so I did not write it.
